title: SSX360 Evidence Pack v1
description: The document written by `ssx360 ledger export` and `ssx360-ledger --export`. It is an unsigned index over signed commit envelopes: the envelopes in the bundle carry Ed25519 signatures, this wrapper carries none and asserts nothing about itself. When the hosted export returns a signed body, that body is nested verbatim under `evidence_pack` so its canonical bytes survive.

exported_at.description: UTC timestamp for the local export.

disclaimer.description: Names the export as evidence mapping, not a certification claim.

bundle.description: Local export: the envelope bundle this wrapper indexes.

evidence_pack.description: Hosted export: the signed response body, byte-identical to what ssx360.com returned. Verify this object, not the wrapper.
